decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed mansard roof extension by reason of size, design, materials and position is not considered to be acceptable. The extension would dominate the roof of the property, resulting in an unacceptable level of bulk at roof level and adversely impacting on the appearance of the pair of dwellings. The proposal is considered to be contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed mansard roof extension by reason of size, design and position is considered to adversely impact on the privacy of the adjoining properties through the extension adjacent to the existing window on the neighbouring property. The proposal is considered to be inconsistent with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a roof extension incorporating a mansard roof, parapet and a roof terrace to both houses.
